description: This file defines a function 'vtws_getchallenge' that generates an authentication token for a user, stores it in the database with an expiration time, and returns the token along with server time and expiration details. It is part of the Web Services authentication mechanism for vtiger CRM.

methods.name: vtws_getchallenge
methods.description: Generates an authentication challenge token for the specified username, stores it with an expiration time, and returns token info.
